name: Host of Spirits
source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands
description: A host of angry spirits inhabiting the ruined house attempts to drag living creatures closer and crush them to death.
disable: DC 43 Religion (master) to exorcise the spirits or DC 45 Deception (master) to trick the spirits into departing
reset: The haunt ends 1 round after no creatures are within 50 feet of the house. The haunt resets after 1 day.
routine: ◆◆◆ For each of its actions, the trap attempts a ghostly hand Strike against a different creature within 50 feet of the ruins of the house (if there are fewer than 3 creatures, the haunt doesn't use its remaining actions).

generalAbilities.name: Embrace of Death
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature that has angered the haunt begins its turn within 50 feet of the ruins of the house

Effect The haunt attempts a ghostly hand Strike against the target creature, and then rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Ghostly Grip
generalAbilities.description: A creature outside the house that takes damage from the host of spirits' ghostly hand Strike must succeed at a Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save or be pulled directly into the house. If there is a wall in the creature's path, that section of wall is destroyed, and the creature takes an additional 3d12 Bludgeoning Damage damage. The haunt's ghostly hand Strike also deals an additional 6d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to a target already inside the house (Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
